description: Check whether a URL is safe to fetch, read, sign in to, or pay — before you do. One verdict with plain reasons: domain age and newborn flag, lookalike of a top site, spam/abuse blocklists, HTTPS, robots.txt for your user agent, how our bot observatory sees your user agent, and the site's own x402 price if it answers 402. Fails closed: 'unknown' means do not proceed. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"url": "https://example.com"}. Returns: data: verdict (likely_safe/caution/high_risk/inconclusive), risk_score, safe_to{fetch,read,sign_in,pay} each yes/caution/no/unknown, actions{...: {answer, why}}, reasons[{risk, why}], domain_age_days, newborn, lookalike, https_valid, robots{allowed, token, status}, http{status, content_type, redirects}, x402{offers[{price_usd, network, pay_to}]}, bot_policy, not_checked[].

ua.description: The user agent you will fetch with; robots.txt and our bot policy are judged for it. Defaults to the User-Agent of this request.

url.description: The http(s) URL you are about to fetch

name: url_preflight
title: URL pre-flight
